name: Innocent Blue
source:
There is a special "VIP Ward" in Mizuno General Hospital. Main character's sister is chosen as a nurse to work there. Soon protagonist gets in a traffic accident and regains consciousness at this hospital. He learns dark secrets of this place as he is given special treatment by his sister.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
水野综合医院内设有一处特殊的“VIP病房”，男主角的妹妹被选中调往那里担任护士。不久之后，男主角遭遇车祸，醒来时发现自己正住在这家医院里。在接受妹妹“特殊看护”的过程中，他一步步揭开了这座病房背后肮脏黑暗的秘密。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
